exposure: Reconstructive surgery for FGM/C using peri- and intraoperative ultrasound imaging with Doppler
outcome: Sexual function (dyspareunia, apareunia, anorgasmia, sexual pleasure)
Minimization of clitoral vascular or nerve injury
cohort: Seven women with FGM/C of classifications Ia to IIIb who were evaluated and underwent reconstructive surgical management at a single institution.
finding: Ultrasound imaging with Doppler can be effectively utilized to guide personalized reconstructive surgery for FGM/C, optimizing both anatomical and functional results including excellent postoperative restoration and sexual function.
